# Insightly

> AI-powered app review analysis. Paste any App Store or Google Play link and get a structured report of user pain points, requested features, and startup opportunities.

Insightly scans public App Store and Google Play reviews with AI to help indie developers and founders find their next product idea, and helps product/ASO teams track competitive intelligence from user feedback.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://insightly.top/): Overview for developers and founders looking for product ideas hidden in competitor app reviews.
- [For Teams](https://insightly.top/for-teams): Competitive intelligence positioning for product and ASO teams.
- [Analyze an app](https://insightly.top/app): Submit an App Store or Google Play URL to generate an AI review analysis report.
- [App Analysis Archive](https://insightly.top/app-insights): Browse previously analyzed apps and competitor comparison reports.

## Blog

- [How to Find App Ideas That People Actually Want](https://insightly.top/blog/find-app-ideas): Using app reviews and AI analysis to spot market gaps and validate a startup idea.
- [App Review Analysis: How to Turn User Feedback into Your Next Big App Idea](https://insightly.top/blog/app-review-analysis): How to analyze app store reviews for ideas, pain points, and feature requests.
